This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail.
The applicant is in custody since 23.12.2022 in connection with Crime No.497/2022 registered at P.S. Omti, Jabalpur for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(n) and 506 of IPC.
The allegation against the present applicant is that he committed rape with the prosecutrix and when she threatened to lodge complaint against him, he agreed to marry her.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant and prosecutrix were consenting party but marriage could not be materialized because of certain reason, however he is ready to marry the prosecutrix.
The prosecutrix is major and present in the Court and she has no objection if the bail is granted to the applicant.
Considering the aforesaid, without adverting to the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

I t is directed that applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court for his appearance on the dates given by the concerned Court.

It is further directed that the applicant shall also comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
It is made clear that in case if the applicant is found involved in any other offence during the pendency of the trial or in future any complaint is lodged against him, this bail order shall stand cancelled automatically.
